capabilities: Materialize selected Canvas text cards into individual Markdown files in place
Record each card's Canvas origin, color and connections in frontmatter fields
Link materialized cards with canvas_out and canvas_in wikilinks
Add canvas-color tags so cards can be grouped by color
Restore a materialized file's card color when dragged back onto a Canvas
intentEvidence: bringing Heptabase-style card-based note-taking to Obsidian, with every connection and color preserved
motivation: To bring Heptabase-style card-based note-taking to Obsidian.
problem: Canvas cards are one-off text locked inside the canvas, so their content and connections can't be searched, linked or queried like regular notes.

relations.evidence: bringing Heptabase-style card-based note-taking to Obsidian

summary: Turns selected Canvas text cards into Markdown files in auto-created folders, preserving card connections and colors as frontmatter and tags.
